item.text: The checkout already uses a single `*sql.DB` in `Db()` and `persistence.New()`. I found two remaining gaps: the SQLite DSN lacks the requested settings, and `WithTx()` can fall back to the global database instead of the connection passed to `New()`. I’ll fix those without adding the conflicting split-connection interface.

Updated the repository to use one SQLite `*sql.DB` pool. [Db()](/app/db/db.go) now applies the requested connection settings, and [WithTx()](/app/persistence/persistence.go) uses the connection passed to `persistence.New()` and keeps repository operations on the transaction.
